identity.name: Daily Maverick
identity.description: An independent South African online news publication known for investigations, analysis, politics, business and social-justice reporting.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Independently owned. Inkululeko South Africa Media, a nonprofit, holds more than 25% and no shareholder holds more than 50%; co-founders Branko Brkic and Styli Charalambous lead the organisation. Funded by membership, advertising, events and grants.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Independent ownership with a nonprofit shareholder and no controlling owner; a strong investigative record on South African corruption and state capture.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC records High credibility but no parsed ideological rating; self-assessed as centrist with a pro-democracy, social-justice orientation.

economicPerspective.evidence: Business coverage is substantial but not uniformly pro-market; investigations often target corporate and state corruption.

internationalAlignment.evidence: South African national lens with strong African democracy, accountability and social-justice coverage.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC records High credibility; Daily Maverick has won awards for investigations and publishes corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: credibility High; no clean bias/factual fields parsed (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: South African investigative and analysis journalism, with a strong accountability and social-justice lens.

selectionRationale: Adds essential South African investigative capacity and an African democracy perspective.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms independent ownership and funding model. Feed validated via dmrss. Minority nonprofit shareholder is a key governance nuance. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
